name: Beothach
description: Terena's power-hungry brother who poisoned their father and is killed by his own rebounding death magic.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terena uses Taradomnu herbs to make a Circle of Protection that reflects Beothach's death magic and kills him.
timeline.quote: making her brother's death magic rebound back onto himself, killing him.
